text: At its meeting on June 20, 2023, the North York Community Council refused an application for a fence exemption at 23 Laurentia Crescent. However, the homeowner's representative did not have the opportunity to present long-term landscaping plans and all safety-related alternatives erected in contrast to the required pool fence. The local Councillor requests that the item be re‐opened at the September 7, 2023, North York Community Council meeting. This motion then requests the aforementioned agenda item to be reconsidered, with given notice, at the next North York Community Council meeting scheduled for October 17, 2023.

North York Community Council: 1. Re‐opened Item NY6.20, titled "23 Laurentia Crescent - Request for a Fence Exemption", adopted by the North York Community Council on June 20, 2023. 2. Directed that item NY6.20 be considered at its next meeting on October 17, 2023, and that Notice be given in accordance with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences.
